{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating wordfreq.mjs.<|"|>}],"files":[{"path":"wordfreq.mjs","content":"import fs from 'node:fs/promises';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import path from 'node:path';

/**
 * Processes text to get word frequencies.
 * @param {string} text 
 * @returns {Map<string, number>}
 */
export function getWordFrequencies(text) {
  const words = text.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z0-9]+/g) || [];
  const counts = new Map();
  for (const word of words) {
    counts.set(word, (counts.get(word) || 0) + 1);
  }
  return counts;
}

/**
 * Sorts and formats the word frequencies.
 * @param {Map<string, number>} counts 
 * @param {number} topN 
 * @returns {string[]}
 */
export function formatFrequencies(counts, topN) {
  const sortedWords = Array.from(counts.entries()).sort((a, b) => {
    if (b[1] !== a[1]) {
      return b[1] - a[1]; // count descending
    }
    return a[0].localeCompare(b[0]); // alphabetical ascending
  });

  return sortedWords.slice(0, topN).map(([word, count]) => `${word} ${count}`);
}

async function main() {
  const args = process.argv.slice(2);
  if (args.length === 0) {
    console.error('Usage: node wordfreq.mjs <file_path> [--top N]');
    process.exit(1);
  }

  const filePath = args[0];
  let topN = 10;

  const topIndex = args.indexOf('--top');
  if (topIndex !== -1 && args[topIndex + 1]) {
    const val = parseInt(args[topIndex + 1], 10);
    if (!isNaN(val)) {
      topN = val;
    }
  }

  try {
    const content = await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf8');
    const counts = getWordFrequencies(content);
    const lines = formatFrequencies(counts, topN);
    for (const line of lines) {
      console.log(line);
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`Error: ${err.message}`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
}

// Check if this module is being run directly
const modulePath = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const isMain = process.argv[1] === modulePath || 
               process.argv[1].endsWith(path.basename(modulePath));

if (isMain) {
  main();
}

{"status":"OK","messages":[{"level":"info","content":"Creating test/wordfreq.test.mjs.<|"|>}],"files":[{"path":"test/wordfreq.test.mjs","content:<|"|>import { test, describe } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert';
import { getWordFrequencies, formatFrequencies } from '../wordfreq.mjs';

describe('wordfreq logic', () => {
  test('getWordFrequencies should count words correctly and strip punctuation', () => {
    const text = 'Hello world! Hello, world. HELLO?';
    const counts = getWordFrequencies(text);
    
    assert.strictEqual(counts.get('hello'), 3);
    assert.strictEqual(counts.get('world'), 2);
    assert.strictEqual(counts.size, 2);
  });

  test('getWordFrequencies should handle empty text', () => {
    const counts = getWordFrequencies('');
    assert.strictEqual(counts.size, 0);
  });

  test('getWordFrequencies should handle alphanumeric characters', () => {
    const text = 'User123 is here. User123!';
    const counts = getWordFrequencies(text);
    assert.strictEqual(counts.get('user123'), 2);
  });

  test('formatFrequencies should sort by count descending then alphabetically', () => {
    const counts = new Map([
      ['apple', 5],
      ['banana', 10],
      ['cherry', 10],
      ['date', 2]
    ]);
    // Expected order: banana (10), cherry (10), apple (5), date (2)
    // Note: banana comes before cherry alphabetically.
    const result = formatFrequencies(counts, 10);
    assert.deepStrictEqual(result, [
      'banana 10',
      'cherry 10',
      'apple 5',
      'date 2'
    ]);
  });

  test('formatFrequencies should respect topN limit', () => {
    const counts = new Map([
      ['a', 1],
      ['b', 2],
      ['c', 3]
    ]);
    const result = formatFrequencies(counts, 2);
    assert.strictEqual(result.length, 2);
    assert.strictEqual(result[0], 'c 3');
    assert.strictEqual(result[1], 'b 2');
  });
});
